item.title: [webauthn-3] Mix up of links for WebAuthn authenticator responses
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Authentication_API/Authenticator_data

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Accessing authenticator data

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The link to PublicKeyCredential.response.authenticatorData for navigator.credentials.create() links to the assertion page (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AuthenticatorAssertionResponse/authenticatorData)

The link to PublicKeyCredential.response.getAuthenticatorData() for navigator.credentials.get() links to the attestation page (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AuthenticatorAttestationResponse/getAuthenticatorData)

What did you expect to see?

I am searching for the assertion (aka authentication) signing of the challenge option sent to credentials.get() using the authenticator's private key.
In searching for that data I noticed the above issue.
I looked at the git entry for that page and it seems that the typo is in a deeper level and not in the HTML/markup

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

Thie section of the WebAuthn API (https://www.w3.org/TR/webauthn-3/#sctn-op-get-assertion) indicates that an assertion is the name for an authorization (AKA a credentials.get())
It simply looks like a typo in a very complex part of the document.

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
